evidence: Static nesting is sound, but required workload fit is unmeasured. The frozen workbook Quality Checks!D12 requires timeouts long enough and nested; Internal Quality Checks!D12 also asks that the sum of judges fit the verifier. In the frozen task, task.toml:18,21,27 sets agent=7200s, environment build=600s and verifier=13200s. Each gate judge.toml:4 is 600s; functional:4 is 9000s, polish:4 and visual:4 are 900s. tests/test.sh:207 runs serially (--max-concurrent-agent 1), :213 assigns gates 1500s and :224 scored 11100s. Arithmetic: each gate 600<1500; serial gate sum 600+600=1200<1500 (300s suite margin); each scored judge<11100; serial scored sum 9000+900+900=10800<11100 (300s margin); suite sum 1500+11100=12600<13200 (600s verifier margin); all judge maxima sum to12000<13200. These timeout values match the frozen template, and test.sh plus both Dockerfiles are byte-identical to it. Liveness is 120 iterations with 0.25s sleeps, with two possible 2s URL probes per iteration (test.sh:42-58,115-125); this is not a guaranteed fixed30s wall clock. The restart helper repeats the probe and has a55s outer tool limit (test.sh:130-183; restart_mcp.py:11,34-43). No measured healthy-app liveness overrun is established. The actual functional workload has145 binary criteria and shared P1-P10/B1-B6 protocols, including role/tier matrices, UI setup, readbacks, invalid/stale/concurrent controls and a final restart; prompt.md:11 requires alternate independent setup after prerequisite failures. The count is directly parsed from the frozen [[criterion]] entries; installed configured-inspection/results.json:96-105 confirms145 criteria,125715 prompt bytes and9000s timeout, but :2 explicitly limits this to parser/schema/CLI construction and OS argument launch, with NO provider grade. Current build-agent.log:22,25 and build-verifier.log:28-46 show cached package/install layers, so successful image assembly does not establish a realistic cold-build duration under600s. targeted-golden/results.json:2 explicitly reports scripted browser evidence, not configured judging, and supplies no full judge duration. runtime-evidence.json is absent in this run. The raw index itself declares full configured workload absent. Thus cold-build sufficiency, full agent-build sufficiency and actual completion of the configured judging workload cannot be upgraded to Pass. counterexample: Analytical alternatives, not measured score claims: a broken app that successfully stores the gate requisition and pending offer but has dead approval/revision actions could still pass those gate observations and may finish early with many missing outcomes; fast timing on that app would not establish time for a complete product, and independent fallback setup can also consume time. A conforming app that exposes the required facts across legitimate separate detail screens can require substantially more navigation than the scripted golden; full completion of145 independently evidenced criteria within9000s is not established by parser launch or arithmetic. Neither a passing broken app score nor a conforming timeout has been measured.
suggested_fix: Keep all canonical budgets unchanged until real current-byte cold-build and full configured workload timing evidence is available; obtain the provider run only under existing separate authorization, record command, duration, completion/failures and artifact hashes in runtime-evidence.json, and assess both normal and fallback workload. If measurement shows overrun, reduce public scope and redundant work together or justify an explicitly authorized timeout change below five hours, preserve shared harness/scoring policy and freeze a new candidate.
